descriptionAdvanced.de: Shooter's Hill ist ein markanter Hügel und Stadtteil im London Borough of Greenwich. Mit 132 Metern über dem Meeresspiegel ist er einer der höchsten Punkte der britischen Hauptstadt und bietet spektakuläre Ausblicke über die Themse bis hin zur City of London und den Essex Marshes. Historisch lag der Hügel an der Watling Street, einer wichtigen Römerstraße, und war berüchtigt als Versteck für Wegelagerer, die Reisende auf dem Weg nach Dover überfielen. Im 18. Jahrhundert wurde hier Severndroog Castle errichtet, ein dekorativer Turm (Folly) zur Erinnerung an einen Sieg in Indien. Während des Zweiten Weltkriegs diente der Hügel als strategische Position für die Flugabwehr. Heute ist Shooter's Hill eine begehrte Wohngegend, die durch ihre weiten Grünflächen wie den Oxleas Wood und den Shrewsbury Park besticht, die Teil des uralten Londoner Waldgürtels sind.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Shooter's Hill egy dombtetőn fekvő lakónegyed London Greenwich kerületében. 132 méteres magasságával ez a város egyik legmagasabb pontja, ahonnan tiszta időben egészen a Wembley stadionig vagy a Kent-i dombságig el lehet látni. A domb neve valószínűleg a középkori íjászati gyakorlatokra utal, bár később a hírhedt útonállók tanyája lett, akik a Doverbe tartó utazókat fosztogatták a Watling Street-en. A 18. században épült Severndroog-kastély egy különleges háromszögletű torony, amely ma is látogatható és pazar panorámát kínál. A környék különlegessége az Oxleas Wood, egy ősi erdőmaradvány, amely túlélt minden városépítési tervet. Shooter's Hill ma egy zöld oázis a nagyvároson belül, ahol a viktoriánus és Edward-kori villák mellett modern társasházak is találhatók, megőrizve a hely nyugodt, szinte vidéki jellegét.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Shooter's Hill reprezintă un punct de reper geografic și istoric în sud-estul Londrei, situat în districtul regal Greenwich. Numele său evocă trecutul militar și de vânătoare al zonei, fiind situat pe traseul strategic al vechiului drum roman Watling Street. Datorită altitudinii sale de 132 de metri, dealul a fost întotdeauna de o importanță militară crucială, servind drept post de semnalizare și apărare antiaeriană în timpul ambelor Războaie Mondiale. Simbolul zonei este Castelul Severndroog, un turn memorial construit în 1784 de Lady James în onoarea soțului ei, amiralul Sir William James. Astăzi, Shooter's Hill este renumit pentru spațiile sale verzi extinse, cum ar fi Oxleas Wood și Jack Wood, care fac parte din siturile de interes științific special. Comunitatea locală este una diversă, profitând de aerul mai curat și de atmosfera de 'sat pe deal' în cadrul metropolei londoneze.
descriptionAdvanced.en: Shooter's Hill is a district in the Royal Borough of Greenwich, notable for being one of the highest points in London at 132 meters (432 feet). Its name originates from the archery practice that took place here in the medieval period, though it later became infamous for highwaymen who preyed on travelers along the Dover Road (Watling Street). The hill offers commandingly clear views of the Thames, the Docklands, and central London. A key landmark is Severndroog Castle, a triangular gothic folly built in 1784. The area played a vital role in national defense, from the Armada beacons to the anti-aircraft batteries of the 20th century. Geographically, it is home to some of London's finest ancient woodlands, including Oxleas Wood, which dates back over 8,000 years. Today, it is a sought-after residential area characterized by its open commons, historic villas, and a unique sense of elevation above the London basin.

en.q: Why was Shooter's Hill dangerous in the past?
en.a: It was a prime spot for highwaymen attacking coaches on the road to Dover.

en.q: Can you see central London from the hill?
en.a: Yes, on a clear day, landmarks like the Shard and Canary Wharf are clearly visible.

en.q: What is unique about Severndroog Castle?
en.a: It is a rare triangular-shaped gothic tower built as a memorial.

en.q: What is the age of Oxleas Wood?
